reentrancy.title: Reentrancy and callback ordering
reentrancy.neg: {subject} must not let a callback or external call re-enter a state-changing path before state is updated; test a malicious receiver that re-enters {surface} and assert balances and accounting are unchanged.
reentrancy.verify: Reentrant attacker contract/test plus an invariant that total accounted value equals total held value.

access-control.title: Access control and privileged roles
access-control.neg: {subject} must refuse every privileged action ({surface}) from an unauthorized caller, a revoked role holder and an uninitialized owner.
access-control.verify: One negative test per privileged entry point asserting the exact revert/error; a test that enumerates public entry points against an expected role table.

precision.title: Integer and decimal precision, rounding, overflow
precision.neg: {subject} must not lose, mint or round value in its favour at boundary amounts (0, 1 unit, max, mixed decimals) for {surface}; rounding must favour the protocol/ledger and never create value.
precision.verify: Property or fuzz test over amount and decimals ranges asserting conservation (sum in == sum out + fees) and exact boundary expectations.

replay-chainid.title: Signature replay, domain separation and chain id
replay-chainid.neg: {subject} must reject a signature or signed message replayed on another chain, another contract or after use, and must bind chain id, verifying contract and purpose for {surface}.
replay-chainid.verify: Test replaying a valid signature across chain id, contract address and a second submission; malleable or truncated signatures are refused.

nonce-idempotency.title: Nonce handling and idempotency
nonce-idempotency.neg: {subject} must process a retried, duplicated or out-of-order submission of {surface} at most once and keep nonces/sequence numbers consistent after a crash and restart.
nonce-idempotency.verify: Submit the same request twice and concurrently, kill and restart mid-flow, assert one effect and a stable nonce.

finality-reorg.title: Finality, confirmations and reorgs
finality-reorg.neg: {subject} must not treat {surface} as final before the required confirmations, and must reverse or reconcile derived state when the observed block, ledger or slot is reorganized or dropped.
finality-reorg.verify: Simulate a reorg (anvil snapshot/revert, ledger rewind or dropped transaction) and assert credits are reversed and no duplicate credit occurs on replay.

key-custody.title: Key custody, MPC and signing boundaries
key-custody.neg: {subject} must never log, persist or transmit key material, and {surface} must sign only through the approved custody/MPC boundary with policy limits; a compromised app server must not be able to sign arbitrary payloads.
key-custody.verify: Log/grep scan with seeded fake key, test that the signer refuses out-of-policy payloads, and that test fixtures use throwaway keys only.

gas-dos.title: Gas, resource limits and denial of service
gas-dos.neg: {subject} must stay within gas/compute/fee limits and not allow an attacker to block {surface} through unbounded loops, huge arrays, dust spam, forced reverts or fee griefing.
gas-dos.verify: Gas/compute snapshot with worst-case inputs; test with maximum-size collections and a reverting recipient.

upgradeability.title: Upgradeability, initialization and migration
upgradeability.neg: {subject} must not allow re-initialization, an unauthorized upgrade, or a storage/account layout change that corrupts existing state for {surface}; upgrades need a delay or multisig and a tested rollback path.
upgradeability.verify: Upgrade test against a fork or snapshot of existing state, storage layout diff in CI, re-initialize attempt asserted to fail.

oracle-trust.title: Oracle and external data trust
oracle-trust.neg: {subject} must reject stale, zero, out-of-range or manipulated external data (price, rate, message) for {surface}, including single-block flash-loan manipulation, and must fail safe when the source is unavailable.
oracle-trust.verify: Mock oracle returning stale/zero/extreme values and a fork test that manipulates a pool within one transaction.

evm.title: EVM (Solidity, Foundry, Hardhat, ethers/viem/web3)
evm.subject: the contract or EVM client
evm.surface: each external or public function and each value transfer

reentrancy.verify: forge invariant test with a handler plus a malicious receiver contract; Slither reentrancy detectors; assert nonReentrant or checks-effects-interactions on every value-moving path.

replay-chainid.verify: EIP-712 domain includes chainId and verifyingContract; test with vm.chainId() changed and with an ecrecover malleable signature.

finality-reorg.verify: Indexer/backend tests that revert to an anvil snapshot (evm_snapshot/evm_revert, a hint, not a true reorg) and tests with the finalized block tag; require N confirmations or finalized before crediting.

scaffolds.title: Local anvil and fork tests
scaffolds.notes: Pin the fork block for determinism; keep RPC URLs and keys out of the repo and logs.

scaffolds.title: Foundry invariant tests with handlers
scaffolds.notes: Use a handler with ghost variables and targetContract/targetSelector; set invariant runs/depth in foundry.toml and review fail_on_revert and show_metrics so reverting handlers cannot hide a vacuous run.

scaffolds.title: Property fuzzing with Echidna or Medusa
scaffolds.notes: Echidna properties return bool; keep a failing control (a deliberately broken variant) to prove the property can fail.

scaffolds.title: Hardhat local network tests
scaffolds.notes: Use hardhat_reset/forking with a pinned block for fork tests.

prompts: List every external/public entry point and its access modifier, and show a negative test for each privileged one.
Walk each value-moving function for reentrancy and cross-function reentrancy; show the attacker test.
Write a Foundry handler-based invariant test for the conservation of value, with a deliberately broken variant that must fail.
Check upgrade safety: initializer guards, storage layout diff, and a fork test of the upgrade against live state.
Review signature flows for chainId, verifyingContract, nonce and deadline binding and malleability.

solana.title: Solana / Anchor
solana.subject: the program
solana.surface: each instruction and each account it accepts

access-control.neg: {subject} must reject an instruction when a signer, owner, PDA seed/bump, program id or account discriminator check fails, and when accounts are substituted, duplicated or passed with the wrong owner for {surface}.
access-control.verify: Anchor tests passing wrong signer, wrong owner, fake PDA and duplicate mutable accounts; has_one/constraint on every account.

reentrancy.neg: {subject} must not be exploitable through cross-program invocation (CPI) re-entry or arbitrary CPI target program ids for {surface}.
reentrancy.verify: Test a malicious program as CPI callee; verify program id of every CPI target.

precision.verify: checked_add/checked_mul on all u64/u128 math, tests at u64::MAX and token decimals 0/6/9; proptest over amounts.

gas-dos.neg: {subject} must stay within the compute-unit budget and account size/rent limits for {surface}; an attacker must not be able to bloat, close-and-revive or starve accounts.
gas-dos.verify: Measure compute units in tests at worst-case account counts; test account closing and revival.

upgradeability.verify: Upgrade authority held by a multisig or revoked; account struct versioning and realloc tests against old serialized data.

replay-chainid.neg: {subject} must not let a signed transaction or message be replayed: stale recent_blockhash, reused durable nonce account state, or a signature reused across programs and clusters for {surface}.
replay-chainid.verify: Test an expired blockhash, a reused durable nonce and a message signed for another program id; assert refusal.

finality-reorg.neg: {subject} must act on {surface} only at the required commitment level (confirmed or finalized, never processed for value) and handle dropped transactions and forks by re-checking signature status.
finality-reorg.verify: Test with commitment levels and a dropped/expired transaction; assert no credit before finalized and no duplicate credit on resubmit.

scaffolds.title: Anchor tests on a local validator
scaffolds.notes: anchor test starts a local validator itself; run solana-test-validator --reset separately only with --skip-local-validator, and never both on the same port.

scaffolds.title: Fast SBF unit and in-process tests (cargo test-sbf, LiteSVM or solana-bankrun)
scaffolds.notes: Use for clock warps and compute-unit assertions.

scaffolds.title: Fuzzing with Trident or proptest
scaffolds.notes: Add a deliberately broken variant to prove the harness can fail.

prompts: For each instruction list the accounts, their owner/signer/seed constraints and the test that passes a wrong one.
Check every CPI for program id validation and signer-seed use, and arithmetic for checked math.
Review account close/realloc paths and upgrade authority custody.

substrate.title: Substrate / Polkadot SDK pallets and runtimes
substrate.subject: the pallet or runtime
substrate.surface: each dispatchable and each hook (on_initialize, on_finalize)

access-control.neg: {subject} must reject unsigned, wrong-origin and non-root calls to {surface}; every dispatchable checks ensure_signed/ensure_root/EnsureOrigin as intended.
access-control.verify: Mock-runtime tests with each origin type; assert BadOrigin.

gas-dos.neg: {subject} must charge correct weights and bound storage iteration for {surface}; no unbounded loops or storage growth that an attacker can force.
gas-dos.verify: Benchmarks with worst-case components, weight regression check, and BoundedVec limits tested.

upgradeability.neg: {subject} must ship a storage migration with version checks for every storage layout change, and runtime upgrades must be tested against a snapshot of live state.
upgradeability.verify: try-runtime on-runtime-upgrade against live state; StorageVersion bumped and checked.

precision.verify: Saturating/checked arithmetic and Perbill/FixedU128 rounding tests at boundaries; proptest over amounts.

replay-chainid.neg: {subject} must bind signed extrinsics to the genesis hash, spec version, transaction version, nonce and mortality era so {surface} cannot be replayed on another chain or after a runtime upgrade.
replay-chainid.verify: Test an extrinsic signed for another genesis hash and an expired era; assert InvalidTransaction.

scaffolds.title: Pallet mock runtime unit tests
scaffolds.notes: Test each origin and error variant.

scaffolds.title: try-runtime and zombienet
scaffolds.notes: Run upgrade tests against a snapshot, not a production endpoint with write access.

scaffolds.title: Property tests
scaffolds.notes: Prove failure with a seeded broken variant.

prompts: List each dispatchable with its origin check, weight and the test for the wrong origin.
Check storage migrations and StorageVersion for every storage item changed in this diff.
Review hooks for unbounded work and weight accounting.

xrpl.title: XRP Ledger (xrpl.js, xrpl-py, rippled)
xrpl.subject: the XRPL client or service
xrpl.surface: each transaction type submitted or observed

precision.neg: {subject} must handle XRP drops (integer) and issued-currency amounts (15-digit mantissa) without floating point, rounding or truncation for {surface}; amounts must be strings, never JS numbers or floats. Credit the delivered_amount of a payment, never its Amount field (partial payments).
precision.verify: Boundary tests with 1 drop, max supply, 1e-15 issued amounts, and round-trip through the library's amount types.

nonce-idempotency.neg: {subject} must manage account Sequence/Ticket numbers and LastLedgerSequence so a retried or duplicated {surface} applies at most once and an expired transaction is never silently resubmitted with a new sequence.
nonce-idempotency.verify: Resubmit identical signed blob, expire via LastLedgerSequence, and assert one validated result by transaction hash.

finality-reorg.neg: {subject} must treat {surface} as final only when the transaction is in a validated ledger (validated: true) with tesSUCCESS, never from tentative or tec/tem/ter results alone.
finality-reorg.verify: Standalone rippled test that submits without ledger_accept (not validated) and with it; assert credits only after validated result.

replay-chainid.neg: {subject} must set NetworkID for networks that require it and reject signed blobs for another network for {surface}.
replay-chainid.verify: Test submit of a mainnet-signed blob against testnet/standalone config.

access-control.neg: {subject} must honour account flags (RequireAuth, DisallowXRP, deposit authorization, regular key vs master key disabled) when handling {surface}.
access-control.verify: Standalone tests with each account flag set.

scaffolds.title: Local standalone rippled
scaffolds.notes: Standalone mode does not advance ledgers automatically; call ledger_accept to validate. Pin any container image by digest; the faucet exists only on test networks.

scaffolds.title: Property tests for amounts
scaffolds.notes: Use hypothesis (xrpl-py) or fast-check (xrpl.js) over drops and issued amounts.

prompts: Show how each submitted transaction is tracked to a validated ledger, with LastLedgerSequence and the retry policy.
Review all amount handling for float use and drops/issued-currency boundaries.
Check regular-key, signing-list and deposit-auth handling for the accounts involved.

ledger-messaging.title: Ledger/journal over protobuf and NATS
ledger-messaging.subject: the ledger service
ledger-messaging.surface: each posting, journal entry and message subject

precision.neg: {subject} must store money as integer minor units or fixed-point decimal and never float; protobuf int64/uint64 fields must be checked for overflow and sign for {surface}.
precision.verify: Property test that every journal balances to zero (debits == credits) across random amounts, currencies and scales.

nonce-idempotency.neg: {subject} must apply a redelivered, duplicated or reordered message ({surface}) exactly once using a durable idempotency key, including after consumer crash and JetStream redelivery.
nonce-idempotency.verify: Deliver each message twice and out of order, kill the consumer between apply and ack, assert balances unchanged by the duplicate.

finality-reorg.neg: {subject} must not acknowledge a message before the posting is durably committed, and must define behaviour for a lost ack, a poison message and a replay from sequence zero.
finality-reorg.verify: Fault test killing the process before/after commit and before ack; replay the stream into an empty store and compare balances.

access-control.neg: {subject} must authorize publishers and subscribers per subject (NATS accounts/permissions) and reject postings from an unauthorized or tenant-mismatched publisher for {surface}.
access-control.verify: NATS permission test with a client lacking publish rights; tenant isolation test.

upgradeability.neg: {subject} must keep protobuf schema evolution backward and forward compatible (no reused field numbers, unknown fields preserved) for {surface}.
upgradeability.verify: buf breaking in CI and a test that decodes messages produced by the previous schema.

key-custody.neg: {subject} must keep NATS credentials, signing keys and database secrets out of logs, messages and config in the repo, and rotate them without replaying {surface}.
key-custody.verify: Secret scan in CI and a test that message payload logging redacts credential fields.

gas-dos.neg: {subject} must bound message size, consumer backlog, pending acks and per-tenant rate for {surface} so a flood or poison message cannot stall the ledger.
gas-dos.verify: Load test with oversized, flooded and poison messages; assert dead-lettering and bounded memory.

scaffolds.title: Local NATS JetStream
scaffolds.notes: Use a throwaway store dir; test redelivery with MaxDeliver and AckWait set small.

scaffolds.title: Ledger property tests
scaffolds.notes: Assert the double-entry invariant after every random operation sequence.

prompts: Prove that every journal balances and that redelivery cannot post twice, with a crash between commit and ack.
Check protobuf schema evolution rules and subject-level authorization.
Review amount types end to end for float or overflow.
